assets.direction: ELECTRIC SHAPE. Outstanding contemporary Swiss graphic-design art, vivid acid-lime sculptural stepped ribbon weaving through bold ultramarine rectangular forms. A carefully designed abstract composition referencing pixels and code but sophisticated, like a celebrated design festival poster.
